ops.title: cc-present tests must set DAEMONKIT_HOME alongside HOME
ops.body:
Since the daemonkit v0.20.9 pin (cc-present v0.31.3), daemonkit resolves every
durable home-derived path — `paths` defaults, the launchd plist dir, the stable
program root — from the passwd database and **ignores `$HOME`**. A test that
only calls `t.Setenv("HOME", dir)` therefore does *not* sandbox anything
daemonkit-derived: `app.Paths()`, `paths.Paths{}.StateDir()`, `ConfigPath()`,
and `TokenPath()` all keep resolving the real `~/.cc-present`. Wave 1 of the
fleet repin found this the hard way — the suite overwrote real user state while
every package still reported `ok`.

**Rule**: every site that points HOME at a temp dir pairs it with
`t.Setenv("DAEMONKIT_HOME", <same dir>)`. Keep the HOME setenv — non-daemonkit
readers (`os.UserHomeDir` in `internal/packs/discover.go`, the
`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` fallback) still use it. `DAEMONKIT_HOME` is read by name at
runtime by daemonkit's `internal/realhome` `EnvOverride`; no daemonkit change is
needed.

The seven current sites: `app.withHome` (config_test.go),
`TestDaemonRuntimeUsesExactServiceAndRoles` (daemon_runtime_test.go),
`daemon.testPaths` (tailnet_test.go), `TestBuildServerDefersGenerationState` and
`startTestDaemon` (scope_test.go), `TestPackList` and `TestPushDryRunPackBlock`
(cli/pack_test.go).

**Never export `DAEMONKIT_HOME` process-wide in CI or shell config** —
cc-orchestrate's `install-binary.sh` uses the same variable name with a
different meaning.

**How to prove the seams are complete.** Passing tests do not prove it; run the
suite with both homes pointed at empty scratch dirs and check what lands:

```sh
rm -rf /tmp/ccp-guard && mkdir -p /tmp/ccp-guard/dk /tmp/ccp-guard/home
env GOMODCACHE="$(go env GOMODCACHE)" GOCACHE="$(go env GOCACHE)" \
    GOPATH="$(go env GOPATH)" DAEMONKIT_HOME=/tmp/ccp-guard/dk \
    HOME=/tmp/ccp-guard/home go test -race -count=1 ./...
find /tmp/ccp-guard/dk -mindepth 1   # must print nothing
```

Anything under the DAEMONKIT_HOME guard came from a test that did not seam
itself. Verified empty on v0.31.3 (2026-07-27). Raise `ulimit -u` before that
run — cc-present has no `scripts/test.sh`, and daemonkit's
`trust.RunVerifierChild` self-execs the test binary (absorbed by
`internal/daemon/main_test.go`'s `TestMain`).
ops.when: editing or adding a cc-present Go test that points HOME at a temp dir, or debugging writes that land in the real ~/.cc-present
